assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is medically necessary
The monitoring is to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The arrhythmias may be contributing to these embolic events
The payer's determination under denial code PR-204 conflicts with this documented clinical need
